page.overview:
Who is Elivalla?

Elivalla was a mercenary hired by Rensor Bolius to help in claiming Corvo Bianco.

Elivalla was a member of Clentaest's mercenary group. During their jobs, Clentaest had saved his life hundreds of times. They were hired by a man claiming to be Lord Rensor Bolius to assist him in reclaiming the Corvo Bianco estate from Geralt of Rivia. Together with the group, Elivalla approached the estate at night after witnessing Yennefer of Vengerberg arrive for a visit.

The next day, they met up with Lord Bolius at the Beauclair market, where one of the group challenged Elivalla to down an entire pint in one go, which he then did. Later that morning, the group went to confront Geralt and Yennefer at Corvo Bianco, stating that Lord Bolius wanted his estate back. They then accompanied Bolius and Geralt to Duchess Anna Henrietta, but were dismissed by Bolius after he learned Geralt was a witcher.

The next day, Elivalla and Clentaest went with Geralt to free a prisoner named Black-Eyed Benno, who had information about Lord Bolius's son. At first, Elivalla mocked Geralt, but was told to stop by Clentaest. While Clentaest and Geralt talked, Elivalla kept watch and alerted the pair when the prisoner transfer passed by. During the assault, Geralt used Aard to blast Clentaest off her horse. Elivalla was angered by this, but Geralt told him to handle the other guard on horseback. The dwarf caught up with the rider and jumped off his horse to push the other rider off.
